correctness.rationale: The ray matrix has precisely 4ab primitive rows ±e_i±f_j; its image lattice has index 2. Appending a constant 1 gives image index 4 with quotient (Z/2)^2. Integral Cartier supports on all 2^a+2^b maximal cones have form h_ij^{s,t}=sp_i+tq_j+c (also boundary a=1 or b=1); modulo characters Pic is generated by c=1. The cube free sum has degree d!volume=2^d a!b!. Independently computed small-pair Smith normal forms and volume for representative a,b. The a=b=1 exception is correctly excluded; finite calculations are corroboration of the all-parameter integral-support argument.
